top_signals.title: Fighting in Ethiopia and the Risk of Regional Spillover
top_signals.summary:
In September, fighting broke out in Ethiopia’s Tigray region between Ethiopian government forces and the Tigray People’s Liberation Front (TPLF), effectively collapsing the 2022 peace deal. In October, Ethiopian forces recaptured an airport and towns from the TPLF and started moving closer to the border with Eritrea. The renewed conflict raised concerns about both increased instability within Ethiopia — particularly as the TPLF joined with several other armed groups under a new Alliance for Survival — and the potential for a new war between Ethiopia and Eritrea. top_signals.title: Sir Martin Sorrell on AI's Impact on Advertising
top_signals.summary: Martin Sorrell, Executive Chairman of S4Capital, says AI is dramatically reducing the time and cost of creating advertising content, forcing agencies to rethink traditional pricing models. He also highlights AI-powered personalization at scale, as brands use data to deliver highly targeted content. Sorrell spoke with Paul Allen on Insight with Haslinda Amin. (Source: Bloomberg)
